===Etymology 1===
{{etymon|en|id=insect|:inh|enm:be<id:bee>|tree=1}}
[[Image:Drinking Bee.jpg|thumb|A '''bee''' ({{senseno|en|Q7391}})]]
From {{inh|en|enm|be|id=bee}}, {{m|enm|bee}}, {{m|enm|beo}}, {{m|enm|bey}}, from {{inh|en|ang|bēo}}, {{m|ang|bīo|t=bee}}, from {{inh|en|gmw-pro|*bijā}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*bijǭ|t=bee}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*bʰey-|t=bee}}. 
{{col-top|2|cog}}
Cognate with {{cog|yol|been|t=bees}}, {{cog|frr|bi|t=bee}}, {{cog|fy|bij|t=bee}}, {{cog|nl|bij}}, {{m|nl|by|t=bee}}, {{cog|de|Biene|t=bee}}, {{cog|li|Bé}}, {{m|li|bie|t=bee}}, {{cog|lb|Bei|t=bee}}, {{cog|wym|byn|t=bee}}, {{cog|vls|bieë|t=bee}}, {{cog|yi|בין|t=bee}}, {{cog|da,sv|bi|t=bee}}, {{cog|fo|býfluga|t=bee}}, {{cog|is|bý}}, {{m|is|býfluga|t=bee}}, {{cog|nb,nn|bie|t=bee}}; also {{cog|ga|beach}}, {{m|ga|meach|t=bee}}, {{cog|gd|beach|t=bee; beehive; wasp}}, {{cog|la|fūcus|t=bee}}, {{cog|lv|bite|t=bee}}, {{cog|lt|bitė|t=bee}}, {{cog|be|пчала́|t=bee}}, {{cog|bg,mk,ru|пчела́|t=bee}}, {{cog|cs|včála}}, {{m|cs|včela|t=bee}}, {{cog|pl|pszczoła|t=bee}}, {{cog|sh|пчѐла}}, {{m|sh|bčela}}, {{m|sh|pčèla|t=bee}}, {{cog|sk|včela|t=bee}}, {{cog|sl|čebela|t=bee}}, {{cog|uk|бджола́|t=bee}}, {{cog|os|биндзӕ}}, {{m|os|бындз|t=fly}}, {{cog|ps|وينه|tr=waynë́, wenë́, wuynë́|t=termite; white ant}}. 
{{col-bottom}}

====Noun====
{{en-noun|s|been<l:dialectal>}}

# {{senseid|en|Q7391}}A [[fly]]ing [[insect]], of the [[clade]] {{taxfmt|Anthophila|clade}} within the [[hymenopteran]] superfamily {{taxfmt|Apoidea|superfamily}}, known for its organised societies (though only a minority have them), for collecting [[pollen]] and (in some species) producing [[wax]] and [[honey]].
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1499|author=w:John Skelton|title=The Bowge of Courte
|passage=His face was belymmed as '''byes''' had him stounge{{nb...}}.}}
#* {{RQ:Spenser Faerie Queene|book=III|canto=XII|text=An angry Wasp th'one in a viall had, / Th'other in hers an hony-laden '''Bee'''.}}
#* {{RQ:Montaigne Florio Essayes|book=II|chapter=12|passage=Can there be a more formall, and better ordered policie, divided into so severall charges and offices, more constantly entertained, and better maintained, than that of '''Bees'''?}}
#* {{RQ:Shakespeare Tempest|act=V|scene=i|page=17|passage={{smallcaps|Ariell}}: / Where the '''Bee''' ſucks, there ſuck I, / In a Cowslips bell, I lie, / There I [[cowch]] when Owles doe crie, / On the Batts backe I doe flie / after Sommer merrily. / Merrily, merrily, ſhall I liue now / Vnder the bloſſom that hangs on the [[bough|Bow]].}}
#* {{RQ:Purchas Flying-Insects|chapter=The Excellency of Bees|page=1|passage='''Bees''' are the moſt excellent of all Inſects vvhatſoever, and expreſſe both vvorth and vvonder in all their vvaies: {{...}}}}
#* {{RQ:Lawrence Sons and Lovers|[[s:Sons and Lovers/Chapter 12|chapter 12]]|text=He stood across in the other garden, beside a bush of pale Michaelmas daisies, watching the last '''bees''' crawl into the hive.}}
#* {{RQ:Economist|date=2012-03-31|title=Subtle poison
|passage='''Bees''' pollinate many of the world’s crops—a service estimated to be worth $15 billion a year in America alone.}}
#* {{RQ:en:CNN|author=Jack Guy|title=Tiny QR codes help scientists track bee movements|url=https://www.cnn.com/2025/01/28/science/bee-tracking-qr-codes-scli-intl/index.html|date=2025-01-28|passage=New insights into '''bee''' movements and life cycles have been uncovered after researchers tracked the insects using tiny QR codes glued onto their backs. {{...}} “This suggests that most of the foraging that the '''bees''' do occurs very close to the hive,” study co-author Margarita López-Uribe, an associate professor of entomology at PSU, told CNN on Monday.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20250308001047/https://www.cnn.com/2025/01/28/science/bee-tracking-qr-codes-scli-intl/index.html}}
# {{lb|en|informal|proscribed}} Any stinging flying insect, especially a [[wasp]].

===Etymology 2===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*bʰeh₂-|id=speak}}
Possibly from dialectal {{m|en|bene}}, {{m|en|been}}, {{m|en|bean||help given by neighbours}}, from {{der|en|enm|been}}, {{m|enm|bene||neighbourly help, prayer, petition, request, extra service given by a tenant to his lord}},<ref>{{cite-web |title=Archived copy |titleurl=http://education.yahoo.com/reference/dictionary/entry/bee |accessdate=4 March 2012 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120616030024/http://education.yahoo.com/reference/dictionary/entry/bee |archivedate=16 June 2012 }}</ref><ref>https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/bee#word-history</ref> from {{der|en|ang|bēn||prayer, request, petition, favour, compulsory service}}, from {{der|en|gmw-pro|*bōni}}, from {{der|en|gem-pro|*bōniz||prayer, request, supplication}}. 

Thus a variant of obsolete {{m|en|ben||prayer; petition}} and {{doublet|en|boon|nocap=1}}. Cognate with {{cog|da|bøn||prayer}}, {{cog|nl|ban||curse}}, {{cog|de|Bann||ban}}. More at {{l|en|ban}}.

====Noun====
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|contest}} A [[contest]], especially for [[spelling]]; see {{m|en|spelling bee}}.
#: {{co|en|geography '''bee'''}}
#* {{quote-av|en|title={{w|Clarence}}|date=24 July 2014|season=1|number=14|text=Hey, guys. Whoa. What are you guys doing? They're setting up in the gym for the Vision '''Bee'''. I signed our team up as "Sumo and the Laser Twins."|writer={{w|Spencer Rothbell}}|actor={{w|Tom Kenny}}|role=Sumo|time=7:02|episode=Puddle Eyes|publisher={{w|Cartoon Network Studios}}|}}
# {{senseid|en|gathering}} A community [[gathering]] to share labour, e.g. a sewing bee or a quilting bee.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1856|author=Samuel Griswold Goodrich|title=Recollections of a Lifetime
|passage=The cellar {{...}} was dug by a '''''bee''''' in a single day.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1973|author=Alan Skeoch; Tony H. Smith|title=Canadians and their society|page=139
|passage=There was but little variation in types of buildings in the pioneer period: house, church, store, barn and mill were usually much alike except in size, and a raising '''bee''' was the ordinary means of their erection.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|author=Tim Blanning|title=The reinvention of the night|journal=Times Literary Supplement|date=21 Sep 2011
|passage=Particularly resistant, for example, in many parts of northern Europe was the “spinning '''bee'''”, a nocturnal gathering of women to exchange gossip, stories, refreshment and – crucially – light and heat, as they spun wool or flax, knitted or sewed.}}
